name: Humanoid
summary: Humanoid (legal name SKL Robotics Ltd) builds industrial humanoids, starting with the wheeled HMND 01 Alpha. It was founded by Artem Sokolov.
funding: $152 million Series A at a $1.35 billion post-money valuation in July 2026; $270 million raised in total.

sources.title: U.K.-based Humanoid secures $152M in Series A funding
